summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, reporting a name change to Dune Oil Corp., effective August 4, 2026, with new trading symbol DUNE on the CSE. The filing also updates a previously announced non-brokered private placement, closing a tranche of 1,030,000 units at CAD$0.15 per unit for CAD$154,500 and settling CAD$168,085.35 in debt via 1,120,569 units. Each unit comprises one common share and half a warrant with a CAD$0.25 exercise price for one year. The name change does not affect shareholder rights or require action. The private placement involves routine equity issuance with no consolidation or special-situations structural change.
